old_story: A man hung from a balloon high in the sky.
He held on to a rope because there was no basket!
The balloon carried him all day, and nobody could land it!
new_story: But there was no basket, only a rope.
In the end, the balloon carried him to work!

old_story: Our boat races a dolphin across the blue sea.
The dolphin jumps high into the sky and lands with a splash!
It wins the race, and it doesn't even have a motor!
new_story: Then the dolphin jumped high into the air.
In the end, the dolphin won without a motor!

old_story: Wearing his gold crown, the old king let a quad bike carry him across the lawn.
He rode it straight through a muddy puddle and laughed his head off.
Nobody bowed to the king that day, but he felt young again!
new_story: Old King Leo rode a quad bike in his crown.
Then he drove straight through a muddy puddle.
Finally, even his crown was muddy!

old_story: A man sits on a bench and reads a book.
His dog sits next to the bench and looks at him.
The dog wants to share the bench too!
new_story: Ben sat on a bench with a book.
Meanwhile, his dog looked at him.
Finally, the dog took the whole bench!

old_story: A man packed a big bag with food and a water bottle.
Then an apple fell out and lay near the blanket.
He picked up the apple and never dropped the bag!
new_story: Sam packed a big picnic bag.
In the end, he ate only the apple!

old_story: After a heavy snowfall, a woman cleared a narrow way along the house.
Then a husky squeezed past her and was the first to use it.
Inside, a man just pointed through the window and showed her the way!
new_story: Anna cleared a narrow way through the snow.
But a husky squeezed past and used it first.
Finally, a man at the window just laughed!

targets: the person in the mustard jumper
story: Max was trying to select the perfect doughnut.
So the girl held the tongs and waited.
In the end, his friend reached over the glass!
captions: Are you carefully selecting a pastry?

classical.picture: a baroque music room: a bear in a white shirt plays the cello, a fox plays the violin, a crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling, a black grand piano
phrases: to play classical music on the cello
story: Bruno the bear plays classical music on the cello.
Meanwhile, the fox plays the violin.
In the end, even the chandelier swings from the ceiling!
captions: The bear switched to classical piano.
Classical music makes the mice dance.
